top.title: Australia v England: third and deciding men’s cricket one-day international – live
top.summary: Updates on the final ODI in the series at Bellerive Oval in Hobart Any thoughts? Get in touch with an email We are indeed very, very proud the culture that this team has built the past eight years. Our players our leaders, our coaches deserve enormous credit for that. In particular Pat and Andrew who continue to lead this team with distinction. But we recognise the pain and the hurt that events surrounding sandpaper have caused. The game is genuinely hurting the moment. It’s not good for anyone. We need to find a path through, we need some time to heal. As of this process, and so all parties who wish to can tell their version of events we have set up now an independent forum, a chance to give everyone a voice in an independent a safe setting. It’s not investigation. It’s not to produce a sanction. No one is forced to participate. It is entirely up to each individual. It’s important to remember we’re talking about events that happened eight a half years ago. And I hope everyone will respect this process the players be afforded the space to at their best at what is a very important time and period for the game. CA CEO Todd Greenberg is ready to speak … For the past week we’ve had several different and conflicting accounts of what occurred in Cape Town in 2018. And it’s an incredibly difficult and uncomfortable time the game and for who was involved. What happened then and continues to play out has a to do with the culture that existed back at the time, a culture that CA played a part in creating. Continue reading...
